title: Best Cooking App
body: I Love this app! It’s the easiest recipe set up to follow. It literally walks you through every step and it was flawless! It’s idiot proof! It made making a pretty complicated dinner super easy and everything came together at the same time. I can’t say enough good things about it thank you! You’re a rockstar!

title: OMG
body: I just discovered Food By Maria on you tube and immediately downloaded and subscribed to the app. There are so many amazing recipes that I can’t wait to try and the ones I have tried are now in my menu plan for good. And, don’t let the number of ingredients scare you, most are pantry staples and spices. Just be grateful you found this app too because it will make menu planning way more fun, interesting and delicious.

title: My weekly go-to
body: This has become my staple for my weekly meal prep and everything in between. I’m obsessed with how delicious the recipes are, the shopping list feature, the layout of the app. Everything. I already followed her on IG and I’m so glad she created this app and not just another cookbook. (No hate, this is just really useful!)

title: O.M.G
body: You guys. This app is amazing. I found her on Instagram, kept looking at all her videos, and made the chicken gyro recipe. I was forever changed that day with her cooking. Her recipes are so easy but packs a punch! You won’t regret buying this app. I’m obsessed with Maria and her recipes!

title: A MUST TRY!!!
body: These recipes are fire!!! We’ve been loving all of them and my husband is a huge fan!!! I found Maria’s app from following her on IG. It’s a wonderful app I love how you can cross off each item as you prepare a recipe. She has easy demonstration videos as well and easy step to step guide. It’s honestly so worth it!!!! HUGE FAN!! We love these recipes thank you Maria!!!!

title: Every recipe is SO GOOD
body: This is such a bang for your buck. So cheap and you get the eat recipes. I make at least 1-2 recipes by Maria every week and they are all delicious.

title: Great feel good food
body: He app is very easy to use. The quality of content is fabulous. What more could you want?!

title: The best
body: Amazing recipes that make cooking so easy!

title: Must Have!!
body: Maris has the most delightful vegan recipes I’ve ever tasted! So grateful to have her as a resource!

title: Friggin’ Delicious Feel-Good Meals!
body: Hands down, THE best vegan meals. Finding meals to make for my plant-based self and my carnivorous husband can be challenging. But I have swayed the beast (more so, Maria) and his favorite dish is now the Zuppa Toscana. Tons of flavor and hearty for the soul! Can’t wait to try some desserts, too. <3

title: A must have app for every food lover
body: This app will make you life way easier in the kitchen . Specially if you are a home cook , and do several things at the same time, is amazing all the different features that it has , it helps you with the time, planning and my biggest issue ... forgetting ingredients ... you can scratch the ingredients that you have or haven’t use ... no more opening windows in the browser looking for the recipe over and over again and getting my cellphone stuffed with food Thank you food by Maria

title: Beyond stunning!
body: This app is absolutely stunning for all reasons! The customizations for every recipe are so genius. I’ve never seen anything like it. You can adjust your servings/ingredient amount, the conversion of your oven temp and even start timers at various steps in the recipe. On top of that the photography is so gorgeous. You are provided with at the least one gorgeous picture of every recipe sometimes more. This app could easily end all cookbooks and I have many. I’ve never felt so connected to an app as I do with a cookbook until now. Congratulations Maria!!

title: Excellent resource
body: I was diagnosed with food allergies a year and a half ago and have since completely altered my diet. Maria’s recipes are wholesome, nutritious, flavorful, and so delicious. They have been a key factor in my learning how to cook vegan food to accommodate my new diet. I rarely feel like I’m missing out on anything because the food is satisfying. Try the Vegan Potstickers and Butter Chicken Curry - my personal favorites!

title: Beautiful and useful!
body: The app is full of amazing recipes!! The subscription is way worth it!! The app has useful features that allow you to mark off ingredients from the list, set up a daily/weekly/monthly meal planner, and is just super easy to use.

title: Great app.
body: It’s hard to find a vegan recipe site as good as this one. Great recipes. Great pictures. Easy to follow instructions. Love the option to cross off the ingredients from the list that you already have so you don’t get confused. Easy to navigate. I just made the Coconut Curry Noodle Soup. It was delicious. It’s the first one I make from the app but surely not the last. Absolutely love it. Congratulations. Great job.
